caseNameFull: Washington, Mayor of Washington, D. C. v. Davis

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 820.] Motion of Educational Testing Service for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Executive Committee of the Division of Industrial Organizational Psychology (Div. 14) of the American Psychological Assn, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted and request to participate in oral argument denied.
